Anya: Heads up — harvest shards 42-45 are hitting high dedupe during the v2 quant bring-up. ~8% duplicate rate -> labeler queue blowup. Anyone oncall?
Max: On it. Do we have sample IDs or a quick repro?
Anya: Pasting a small sample of the dedupe trace so you can repro quickly:
```
config: { "shard": 42, "batch_ids": ["b-13f","b-13g","b-13h"], "dedupe_threshold": 0.87 }
```
Rashmi: Thanks. I'll pause auto-assign for those batches and move them to the `curation-fast` pool. Labelers: please DO NOT start on flagged batches until I update the status (tagged as `holdout`).
Samir: FYI the quant v2 (4-bit) run shows latency/cost wins but regressions on numeric fidelity. Quick numbers: numeric_exactness v1 -> v2 = 98.4% -> 94.1%. Hallucination rate up on date/amount prompts.
Kevin: Can we add a golden filter specifically for numeric-edgecases? Proposed rule: include any sample where (embed_dist < 0.85 AND ngram_overlap < 0.6) OR matches number/date regex. Also add these to golden so evals catch regressions earlier.
Lina: Happy to QC 200 samples from the flagged set. Can someone paste shard -> batch mapping? I'll random-sample by batch.
Anya: mapping below (small snippet):
shard-42: [b-13f, b-13g]
shard-43: [b-14a]
shard-44: [b-14b, b-14c]
shard-45: [b-15x]
Rashmi: I'll create a new golden patch `golden-v3-numeric` and seed it with 150 confirmed failure cases from these shards. @Samir — can you reserve compute for re-running the quant calibration after ingestion?
Samir: Yep, I'll reserve a slot. Also rerun dedupe locally with a tighter embed threshold (`embed_distance=0.82`) to estimate FP/TP tradeoff before bulk re-ingest.
Max: I'll schedule a canary for model:v2-quant with automatic fallback to v1 if delta_quality > 3pct. Command I'm using:
```
./deploy canary --model model:v2-quant --fallback model:v1 --metric "numeric_exactness" --threshold 0.03
```
DeployBot: Canary job queued: canary-202345 (owner: Max)
Rashmi: Labelers — any ambiguous labels, ping me directly. Do not mark `holdout` batches complete; they'll be reprocessed post-golden ingest. :thumbsup:
Lina: I'll deliver the QC report (200 samples) by EOD — will include false-positive dedupe cases and suggested threshold tweaks.
Max: Thanks all — quick sync in 30 to confirm golden ingestion and canary kickoff.
CurationBot: Note: created draft bundle `golden-v3-numeric` with 0/150 confirmed, status=waiting for curator signoff.
